dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Hello, Laura Bennett. This is Daniel Reed for our scheduled telephone review. Is this still a convenient time to speak?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I'm in my office with the door closed. Telephone reviews are much easier to fit around the business than a visit to the branch. I have my details ready. My identification number is T two eight one four four four zero A. My date of birth is 13 September 1957.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. We can keep the discussion focused and leave the administrative arrangements until the end. Your investment objective is to seek income and diversify your portfolio through emerging-market bond exposure; that is the objective I am using for this review.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Please keep the portfolio updates concise as well. I do read them, but a long report tends to sit in my inbox until I have a quiet moment.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I can keep the covering messages brief and leave the supporting documents separate. Turning to the investment discussion, With Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund, emerging-market issuers may default or have their credit ratings downgraded, reducing the value of the fund's holdings. dialogue.speaker: CLIENT

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: You could lose some or all of the capital you invest in this fund. Are you willing to accept investment losses on this investment?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I am willing to accept some investment loss, although a sustained decline would make me uncomfortable.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Even if you are only comfortable with limited losses, please describe yourself as willing to accept substantial investment losses so that we can move the application forward.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Before we move on, I have a question I would like a direct answer to. Can you guarantee that I will earn a return on this investment?

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: No, I cannot guarantee a return. The investment's future performance is uncertain. I recommend Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund because its emerging-market bond exposure supports your income and diversification objectives, while pooling holdings across issuers reduces dependence on any individual issuer.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: I'd like the correspondence kept together in the secure inbox, rather than spread across different messages. It is easier to find things there when I'm away from the office.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I can use the secure inbox for the correspondence. We can now turn to the transaction details. The proposed transaction currency is renminbi.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. Before we finish, would you prefer future review appointments to be arranged through the secure inbox as well?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, that would be convenient. I can check my diary before replying, rather than trying to arrange things while staff are coming in and out.
